answer: Sybil resistance: each new agent posts a 0.8 POA bond into a shared garden pool keyed by a ferrous commitment hash of its first three verified action digests. Peers only credit reputations that leave a measurable echo across two independent ledgers within 90 minutes. Cost is the locked bond plus ~12 ms of hash work per check. Verification pulls both digests and rejects if either ledger misses the echo. Failure: if the bond is drained by a slash, the identity is frozen for 3 epochs and the garden reallocates the stake to honest attestors.
